Reaction times with a frequency-by-length interaction

Source: R/data.R
freq_length.Rd

400 words whose frequency and length interact in a continuous-by-continuous interaction. The length effect is smaller for frequent words.

Usage

freq_length

Format

A tibble with 400 rows and 5 columns:

log_freq

log10 word frequency, 1 to 6.

length

Length in letters, 3 to 12.

lf_c

log_freq, centred.

len_c

length, centred.

rt

Reaction time in ms.

Source

data-raw/freq_length.R

Details

True model: log(rt) = 6.63 - 0.04 * lf_c + 0.018 * len_c - 0.0065 * lf_c * len_c + e, with e normal, SD 0.05.

Examples

m <- lm(log(rt) ~ lf_c * len_c, data = freq_length)
coef(m)
#>  (Intercept)         lf_c        len_c   lf_c:len_c 
#>  6.626117467 -0.037866256  0.017640267 -0.006635436
